A. 风海流、暖流、寒流
B. 补偿流、暖流、寒流
C. 密度流、寒流、暖流
D. 风海流、补偿流、密度流
Need choose correct. Ocean currents classified by cause/dynamic: wind-driven (风海流), density (密度流), compensation (补偿流). Warm/cool are by temperature relative to sea area. So D.
Need final line exactly "答案：D". Maybe include short explanation? User asked answer. Desired final format last line. We can provide concise. Ensure last line.
content:
洋流按产生的动力不同，可分为风海流、补偿流和密度流；暖流和寒流是按水温性质分类的。

答案：D
